# 1 Enoch Chapter 82 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 82 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 82:3 — 'shall not sleep' as a wisdom metaphor

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "those-who-understand-it-shall-not-sleep" | Literal; vigilance is demanded by this wisdom |
| LOGOS | "those who understand it shall not sleep" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "Those who truly grasp it will not sleep" | Adds 'truly' for emphasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. 'Shall not sleep' is the image in the source — the wisdom is so compelling it keeps one awake. PNEUMA's 'truly' is an addition without Ge'ez basis.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/EMET.

---

## 82:13 — The names of the four seasonal leaders

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | Milki'el, Hel'emmelek, Mele'jal, Narel | Preserves Ge'ez transcription |
| LOGOS | Milki'el, Hel'emmelek, Mele'jal, Narel | Same |
| PNEUMA | Same names | All three agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three converge on preserving the Ge'ez angel names as given. These four seasonal angels divide the year into four 91-day quarters. No scholarly consensus on Hebrew/Aramaic etymologies; some scholars read 'Milki'el' as 'my king is El.'

**Status:** Converged.

---

## 82:16 — The signs of Milki'el's season

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "sweat, and-heat, and-calms" | Literal list of spring/summer signs |
| LOGOS | "sweat and heat and calms" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "heat and perspiration, calm weather" | Reorders for natural English; adds 'weather' |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS order. The Ge'ez list order (sweat, heat, calms) is preserved. The signs identify this as the spring quarter (not summer — wheat harvest and roses identify this as late spring/early summer, i.e., March-June in the Palestinian calendar).

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/EMET. Source order preserved.

---
